changes: Add standalone map 613, The Thirteen Steps, outside the continental atlas. Enter with .hack//teleport 613 in the southeast player bedroom. The wooden cabin has thirteen front stone rises, four separate bedrooms with native stat symbols, central corridors, a back door and service stair. Add an open grass field, forest glades, visible resource patches, forge shelter, roofed mine and deeper undead chamber.

Implement three persistent residents: Manu is priest, cook and healer; Yemo is miner and smith; Trito is hunter and protector. Manu and Yemo use the same household purse and stores. Trito has his own carried items, earnings, equipment and bedroom savings chest. Residents physically navigate to resources, carry goods home, work for bounded durations, meet to trade, and return to their own beds at night when no urgent need intervenes.

Run a bounded ecology: rabbits consume the same herb patches that residents and players gather, lose energy and speed with hunger, and disappear without valuable loot after starvation. Herb, wood and ore patches recover gradually. Rabbit replenishment depends on available herbs and is capped; the deeper mine emits at most two undead during the night.

Transfer real items and weighed silver with receipts. Stock limits and available household silver constrain buying; prices decline with supply. Cooking consumes meat and fuel; herbal dressings consume herbs; repairs consume ore and fur; refining adds a recorded amount of silver. Silver blades consume sixteen silver as material and transfer four as the smith’s fee. Reusable hunting snares are available. Trito deposits excess money in a physically accessible, lootable chest.

Give each visitor a realm-only satchel, twelve opening silver, trial knife, equipment condition, hunger and health, plus a personal room chest. Native attack inputs invoke trial strikes. Undead can injure nearby observing visitors; defeat recovers the visitor in their room without deleting possessions. Inspect residents, stocks and transaction history from a responsive ledger, then approach the actor, resource or chest to interact.

Install one authoritative online simulation with authenticated presence, proximity checks, bounded receipt replay, serial mutation/persistence, rollback on a failed transaction save, reconnect recovery and private visitor inventories. Online state is saved beside the configured memory file as .realm613.json. Offline play uses a separate browser ledger; no offline state is uploaded or merged into shared play. No empty-server catch-up; simulation pauses with no observers.

Reuse the configured character model for nearby resident conversations and optional, constrained next-goal choices at most once per three observed minutes. Facts come from actual inventories, activity, needs and receipts. Model output cannot create goods, silver, rewards or arbitrary actions. Existing model-budget checks apply. Without a key, budget or successful response, deterministic decisions and factual dialogue continue.

Preserve the campaign on entry/exit: save before teleporting, isolate memory, inventory, cards, party and progression in memory, block realm autosaves from overwriting the campaign save, then restore campaign fields on exit. Keep v108 Tintagel geography, court story, startup repairs and Suncat navigation unchanged. Devlog shows v109 first, with a condensed v108 entry and older grouped summaries.

limitations: Files only. The user must commit all five matching replacements to publish the client and server.

Browser/local-preview access was previously denied. No alternate browser, headless browser, CDP or screenshot workaround was used. The cabin proportions, roof visibility, stat plaques, touch controls, shadows and actual phone performance need a playtest.

Live model conversation quality and optional goal selection are wired but unverified against the provider. Deterministic fallback and allowed-goal validation were tested. No model/API spending was performed for these tests.

This is a deliberately bounded household experiment, not a worldwide economy or open-ended NPC planner. Resources replenish on timers; the model chooses permitted goals. Hunting snares improve capture strikes rather than simulating a separate trap-setting profession.

Online and offline versions are separate realms with no merge. Shared online stock and Trito’s chest are visible to everyone observing this server realm; each visitor’s satchel and personal chest are private. Starting visitors receive twelve explicit opening silver.

The new server ledger requires the same durable hosting storage as the existing memory file. Periodic movement/need snapshots save every ten active seconds; trade receipts save before acknowledgement. There is no simulation catch-up during downtime.

Economic balancing may need tuning after player interference. Taking Trito’s savings really removes them; depleted reserves can stop buying until spending or refining replenishes the household. This is observable behavior, not a guarantee that arbitrary player disruption cannot cause shortages.
